kerry_cottager.text: Come in and sit. In Kerry, 'sure look it' is a whole sentence. It means 'what can you do?', and it is the answer to everything.
Killarney has the last truly native herd of red deer in Ireland. The stags roar in autumn, and the Fawnlets hide in the bracken.
Daniel O'Connell, the Liberator, was born near Cahersiveen in 1775. We say that to visitors, and they say 'who?', and we say it again.
